question: What should the new user onboarding experience look like?
claude_position: Auto-detect capabilities (2 seconds), ask ONE question (work style: Fast/Balanced/Full Power), done. No subscription picker, no model selector. Make the user feel smart by default.
gpt_position: Agree. Asking about subscriptions is wrong — users think in work preferences, not plan tiers. Add non-blocking API cost guardrail if metered key detected.
synthesis: One-question onboarding: auto-detect available providers, pick work style, start working. No plan questions. Conservative API defaults when metered keys detected. Total setup under 5 seconds.
